design_philosophy.name: Clinical Industrial
design_philosophy.description: A precision-first aesthetic blending high-end laboratory cleanliness with industrial functionality. Think 'Aesop meets SpaceX'.
core_principles: Data Density over Decoration: Every pixel must serve a purpose.
High Contrast: Black text on white surfaces for maximum legibility in warehouse lighting.
Technical Typography: distinct fonts for headings, body, and data.
Visual Zoning: Use specific color accents to denote manufacturing stages.

instructions_to_main_agent: WIPE /app/frontend/src/App.css content. It contains default React styles which conflict with our system.
WIPE /app/frontend/src/index.css and replace with Tailwind directives + Custom Font Imports.
MODIFY /app/frontend/tailwind.config.js to extend the theme with our 'Clinical Industrial' colors and fonts.
Use 'Chivo' font for all Headings (h1-h3). Use 'JetBrains Mono' for ANY data point (IDs, Stock Counts, Dates, Prices). Use 'Inter' for labels and paragraphs.
Do NOT use rounded-xl or rounded-2xl. Maximum border radius is 'rounded-sm' (2px) or 'rounded-md' (4px). We want a sharp, technical look.
For the Dashboard, use a high-density Bento Grid. Do not leave large empty spaces.
Use the provided image URLs for section headers or background accents (with low opacity).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
For 'Stage Tracking', use a progress stepper with the Stage Colors defined in colors.palette.stages.
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (sharp/pill) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 in the UI.
